name: prompt-forge
description: prompt-forge: forges loose prompts, agent briefs and goals into outcome-focused briefs for Claude Code.

plugins.name: prompt-forge
plugins.description: Forges the first prompt of a session, large prompts, large agent briefs and every /goal into an outcome-focused brief behind an isolated model call, so the agent never sees your loose wording.

plugins.name: prompt-forge-view
plugins.description: Shows prompt-forge's forged prompts in the chat, the desktop app included.
